mapper.select: SELECT b.instance_id, d.cruise_result, f.dict_note AS cruiseResultName, b.end_time, d.picpath, d.identify_result, k.dict_note AS 'identifyResultName', ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(e.mete_name) AND ISNULL(g.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(h.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(e.mete_name) AND ISNULL(g.inspection_name) THEN h.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(e.mete_name) AND ISNULL(h.preset_name) THEN g.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(g.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(h.preset_name) THEN e.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(g.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( e.mete_name, ' /', h.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(h.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( e.mete_name, ' /', g.inspection_name ) END ) AS cruise_name FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail b ON a.instance_id = b.instance_id JOIN t_cruise_data_result d ON b.cruise_result_id = d.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business f ON d.cruise_result = f.dict_code AND f.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business k ON d.identify_result = k.dict_code AND k.col_name = 'identify_result' LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete e ON a.device_mete_id = e.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection g ON a.cruise_id = g.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset h ON a.cruise_id = h.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result c ON b.task_result_id = c.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_result m ON b.task_result_id = m.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business n ON m.c_state = n.dict_code AND n.col_name = 'task_state' WHERE a.device_id = #{deviceId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND m.c_state != 239 AND m.c_state != 241 ORDER BY b.end_time DESC LIMIT 1
